e2ee.title: End-to-End Encryption
e2ee.lockedDescription: End-to-end encryption ensures not even NexoMind can read your entries. Available exclusively on the Premium+ plan.
e2ee.readyDescription: Encrypt your journal with a passphrase only you know. Your entries will be unreadable to anyone without it, including us.
e2ee.disclosure: Your entries are encrypted with a key derived from your passphrase. Even we cannot read your journal. If you forget your passphrase, your data is permanently unrecoverable.
e2ee.llmAvailable: Chrome Prompt API detected. Analysis runs entirely on your device.
e2ee.llmUnavailable: No on-device LLM detected. Analysis will be limited until browser support is available.
e2ee.llmUnavailableNotice: On-device analysis paused (no supported LLM detected)
e2ee.modal.step1Description: Choose a strong passphrase (at least 12 characters). This is the only key to your encrypted data.
e2ee.modal.passphraseHint: Minimum 12 characters. Use a mix of words, numbers, and symbols.
e2ee.modal.passphraseError: Passphrase must be at least 12 characters
e2ee.modal.step2Description: Type your passphrase again to make sure you have it memorized.
e2ee.modal.irrecoverableWarning: If you forget your passphrase, your encrypted entries cannot be recovered. There is no reset option. NexoMind does not store your passphrase and cannot decrypt your data.
e2ee.modal.acknowledgment: I understand that if I lose my passphrase, my encrypted journal entries will be permanently inaccessible.
e2ee.modal.success: End-to-end encryption is now active. Your entries are private.
e2ee.modal.activationError: Failed to activate E2EE. Please try again.
